abilities.name: Coven Guard

abilities.name: Scythed Runners

abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Bestial Instincts
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Drakespawn’s Ferocious Jaws while it is in combat with any damaged enemy units or while it is in combat with any enemy units that have had any models slain.

abilities.name: Glorious Martyrs
abilities.effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. abilities.name: Devastating Charge

abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each model in this unit that is in combat. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Fusiliers, Fire!

abilities.name: Blackpowder Squire

abilities.name: Oathsworn

abilities.name: Gromril Shieldwall

abilities.name: Searing Beam of Light

Inflict D3 mortal damage on each visible unit (friendly and enemy) that the line passes across.

abilities.name: Aura of Protection

abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target within 3" of a friendly Morathi-Khaine or Shadow Queen.

abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the unmodified charge roll. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Eater of Fate
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Disciples of Tzeentch unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: If the target is destroyed this turn, before removing it from play, gain 1 fate point.

abilities.name: Steward of the Realm
abilities.effect:

• All attacks that would target the Steward target this terrain feature instead.

abilities.name: Reigning Champion

abilities.effect: Place the target on this terrain feature. The target is now the Steward (see ‘Steward of the Realm’).

abilities.name: Ruler of All They Survey
abilities.declare: If this terrain feature has a Steward, pick a visible friendly non-Hero Flesh-eater Courts unit that is not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target can move D3". If the target was set up this turn, it can move D6" instead. It cannot move into combat during that move.

abilities.name: Duty Calls
abilities.effect: If this terrain feature has a Steward that was not placed on it this turn, set up the Steward on the battlefield wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer the Steward.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged

abilities.name: The Staff of Power
abilities.effect: Add 2 to casting rolls for this unit while it has not miscast any spells this turn. If this unit miscasts a spell, ignore the restriction that would stop this unit from casting any more spells this turn.

abilities.name: Hand of Dust
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy Hero or Monster in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Hide a dice in one of your hands or under one of two appropriate containers. Your opponent must pick one of your hands or containers. If they pick the one hiding the dice, this ability has no effect. If they pick the empty one, the target is automatically destroyed.

abilities.name: Supreme Lord of the Undead
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-Hero non-Unique Death unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Invocation of Nagash
abilities.declare: This unit can cast this spell more than once per phase. Pick a visible unit wholly within 18" of this unit that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect:
If the target is an enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on it. If the target is a friendly Death unit, pick 1 of the following effects:
• Return a number of slain models to the target unit with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.

abilities.name: Utter Contempt
abilities.effect: This unit ignores the effects of Delusion abilities.

abilities.name: Arrest those Miscreants

• Ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for that unit.

abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units that this unit passed across this phase to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If any models are slain by this ability, this unit has Ward (5+) for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Threshing Doom
abilities.effect: When this unit moves, it can pass through models in enemy Infantry units and can pass through the combat ranges of enemy Infantry units, but it cannot end a move in combat unless specified in the ability used.

abilities.name: Thrillseeking Cavalcade
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly Seeker Chariot units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for this unit and the targets for the rest of the turn. In addition, for the rest of the turn, when this unit and the targets use the ‘Mutilating Blades’ ability, add 1 to the amount of mortal damage inflicted (if any).

abilities.name: Mutilating Blades
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Lust for Violence
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly Daemonettes unit that has not used a Fight ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a Fight ability immediately after the Fight ability used by this unit has been resolved.

abilities.name: Lithe and Swift
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Ravaging Claws for the rest of the turn if this unit charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: Excess of Blades
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the unmodified charge roll for that Charge ability. For each roll that exceeds the target’s Save characteristic, the target suffers 1 mortal damage.

abilities.name: Indulgence Given Form
abilities.effect: Each time an enemy unit uses a command while it is within 12" of this unit, give 1 indulgence point to this unit, to a maximum of 6.

abilities.name: Sublime Harmonies
abilities.effect: While this unit’s Vashtiss is on the battlefield, it has Wizard (1). In addition, each time you make a casting roll for this unit, you can spend any number of indulgence points it has. For each point spent, add 1 to the casting roll.

abilities.name: Slicing Fervour
abilities.effect: This unit has Strike-first while it is in combat with a blissmarked unit.

abilities.name: Blissbarb Shafts
abilities.declare: If this unit’s Hadzu is on the battlefield, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 4+:
• Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
• The target is blissmarked for the rest of the turn.

units.name: Syll'Esske, the Vengeful Allegiance (Scourge of Ghyran)

abilities.name: Wandering Minds
abilities.declare: Pick up to 1 visible friendly non-Hero Sybarite Infantry unit and up to 1 visible friendly non-Hero Hedonites of Slaanesh Daemon Infantry unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: If you picked a Sybarite target, subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by its combat attacks until the start of your next turn. If you picked a Daemon target, it has Ward (5+) until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Violent Offerings
abilities.effect: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy Wizard or Priest by this unit’s combat attacks this turn and that enemy unit has been destroyed, add 1 to this unit’s power level for the rest of the battle. This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

abilities.name: Champions of the Gilded Throne
abilities.effect: When players are alternating picking units to use a Fight ability, when it is your turn to pick a unit, instead of picking 1 unit, you can pick a friendly non-Hero Hedonites of Slaanesh Daemon unit wholly within 18" of this unit and a friendly non-Hero Sybarite unit wholly within 18" of this unit. Resolve the second Fight ability immediately after the first.

abilities.name: Veiled Threat
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit in reserve waiting in ambush. It has now been deployed.

abilities.name: Bestial Onslaught
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it is waiting in ambush.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Instinctive Advance
abilities.effect: This unit can move up to 3" immediately after that command has been resolved, unless that command is a reaction, in which case this unit can move after the ability that it was reacting to has been resolved. That move can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units, and can end in combat.

abilities.name: All Must Burn
abilities.declare: Pick 2 or more visible enemy units within 8" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Immolation Cannons for each unit picked to be the target of this ability, but each time this unit uses a Shoot ability, it must target each of those units with at least 3 of its attacks.

abilities.name: Daemonic Strength
abilities.effect:
For each daemonic power point this unit has:
• Add 1" to its Move characteristic
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its weapons.

abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, roll 2D6. This unit can move a distance up to the value of the roll. during that move, this unit can pass through models in the target unit but must end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Peerless Among Daemonsmiths
abilities.effect:
Apply the effect below that corresponds with the number of daemonic power points this unit has:
1 This unit has Ward (6+).
2 Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit. In addition, this unit has Ward (5+).
3 Add 2 to casting rolls for this unit. In addition, this unit has Ward (4+) against damage inflicted by Spells, Prayers, and abilites used by Manifestations. Otherwise, it has Ward (5+).

abilities.name: The Curse of Stone
abilities.declare: Pick a point on the battlefield within 9" of this unit, then pick a second point on the battlefield within 9" of the first point. Draw a line between the caster and the first point, and between the first and second points. Each enemy unit the lines pass across is a target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of Ghorrakos's Horns and Hooves is 4.

abilities.name: Master of Daemonic Power
abilities.effect: Remove up to 3 daemonic power points in total from any combination of friendly units wholly within 18" of this unit. Then, allocate them to a different friendly non-Hobgrot Helsmiths of Hashut unit wholly within 18" of this unit.

abilities.name: Unholy Stampede
abilities.effect:
While a friendly Helsmiths of Hashut Cavalry unit is wholly within 12" of this unit:

• No mortal damage is inflicted on that unit by Retreat abilities.

abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target's Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

abilities.effect:

abilities.effect: Heal (D3+X) the target, where X is the number of daemonic power points this unit has.

abilities.name: 'Fight, You Scum!'

abilities.name: Scorched Remains

abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract an amount equal to the roll from the target's control score until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Manglers of Metal
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s ranged weapons for each daemonic power point this unit has.

abilities.name: Zealous Counter-Attack
abilities.effect: This unit has Strike-first for he rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Crush the Unworthy
abilities.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for each daemonic power point it has.

Set up this faction terrain either as 1 terrain feature consisting of 2 scenery pieces (that must be set up within 3" of each other) or as 2 separate terrain features. Set up each terrain feature wholly within friendly territory and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features. After you have done so, it has been deployed.
If this faction terrain is set up as 1 terrain feature consisting of 2 scenery pieces, it has a Health characteristic of 14 instead of 7.

abilities.name: Guardians of the Deep
abilities.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for friendly Idoneth Deepkin Infantry and Cavalry units while they are wholly within 6" of this terrain feature.

abilities.name: Phantasmal Ruin
abilities.effect:
Models can pass through this terrain feature but cannot be set up on or end moves on any part of this terrain feature.
Each time an enemy unit ends a move that passed through or across this terrain feature, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Phase Ink
abilities.declare: If this unit’s Cephanyr is on the battlefield, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Cyreni of the Abyss
abilities.effect: While this unit’s Cyreni of the Abyss is on the battlefield, it has **^^Wizard (1).

abilities.name: Elathain's Lurelight
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, return a number of slain models to this unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Soulnet
abilities.declare: If this unit’s Elathain Ill-fated is on the battlefield, pick an enemy Infantry unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

abilities.name: Crushing Coil
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly Idoneth Deepkin Manifestations that target an ensnared enemy unit.

abilities.name: Watery Clutch
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this Manifestation to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target's Health characteristic, the target is ensnared for the rest of the turn.
A unit cannot use commands while it is ensnared.

abilities.name: Surrender to the Sea
abilities.effect: When this Manifestation is removed from play, each friendly Abyssal Tendril on the battlefield is automatically removed from play.

abilities.name: Grasping Tendrils
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if it is your turn.
On a 4+:
• You can remove 1 friendly Abyssal Tendril from the battlefield.
• If there are fewer than 2 friendly Abyssal Tendrils on the battlefield, you can set up an Abyssal Tendril wholly within 9" of this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Wild Form
abilities.effect: Each time this Manifestation is targeted by the ‘Banish Manifestation’ ability, if it would be banished, it is not banished. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

abilities.name: The Surging Sea
abilities.declare: Pick this unit and up to 1 friendly Idoneth Deepkin unit within this unit's combat range to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the targets, to a maximum of 3.

abilities.name: Rapid Approach
abilities.effect: This unit can use a Run ability and still use Charge abilities later in the turn

abilities.name: Siren Song of The Abyss
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly Idoneth Deepkin units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets' Companion weapons.

abilities.name: Crushing Pressure
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the target's Health characteristic, to a maximum of 10. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Storm of Blades
abilities.effect: This unit can use 2 Fight abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Whirlpool's Fury
abilities.effect:
Enemy units cannot use Retreat abilities while they are in combat with this unit.
Friendly units that use a Retreat ability while they are wholly within 12" of this unit can still use Shoot and/or Charge abilities later in the turn.
No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly Idoneth Deepkin units by Retreat abilities while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Shrine Guardian
abilities.effect:
While this terrain feature has a Shrine Guardian:
• This terrain feature has a Move characteristic of 6" and can use non-command non-Charge Move abilities as if it were a unit. It cannot end a Move ability within the combat range of an enemy unit.
• The Shrine Guardian cannot use Move abilities and remains on this terrain feature each time it moves.
• Instead of measuring range or visibility to the Shrine Guardian, measure to this terrain feature instead.
• All attacks that would target the Shrine Guardian target this terrain feature instead.
• If this terrain feature is destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the Shrine Guardian. Then, set up the Shrine Guardian on the battlefield wholly within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer a Shrine Guardian. If it is not possible to set up the Shrine Guardian, it is slain.

abilities.name: Enter the Shrine

abilities.effect: Place the target on this terrain feature. The target is now a Shrine Guardian (see ‘Shrine Guardian’).

abilities.name: Cleansing Rituals
abilities.effect: While this terrain feature has a Shrine Guardian, you can re-roll the casting roll for that spell.

abilities.name: Exit the Shrine

abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect:
Roll 10 dice. For each 6:
• Give the target 1 necrotic withering point.
• Roll an extra dice.
For each 5+ on those extra dice, repeat the above bullet points. Then, do the same for each 4+, and then each 3+. Finally, for each 2+, give the target 1 necrotic withering point (do not roll any extra dice),

abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

Roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the following effects for the rest of the turn:

• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly Vongrim Salvagers and Vongrim Harpoon Crew units for attacks that target a unit that is contesting the target objective

While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly Arkanaut Company unit:
